demandSubtitle: Remember what customers could not buy. Review, restock and track real recovered sales.
recoveredHint: Only linked confirmed invoice amounts, after discounts. Cancelled sales are excluded.
peopleHint: Optional reported count. This is not a count of identified customers or requested units.
permission: Customer permits a follow-up about this request
consentHint: Save only permission actually given. No message is sent automatically.
requestSaved: Request recorded. Stock and sales are unchanged.
noDemandHint: Record a product a customer could not buy. It stays separate from your sales.
noReservation: Stock is not reserved. Multiple requests may refer to the same available units.
draftHint: Planning only. No supplier order is sent and no stock changes until you confirm received goods.
receiptHint: Confirm only after these goods arrive. This records a real purchase and stock receipt.
followupHint: Mark only after you actually contacted the customer. Preparing or copying a draft does not count as contact.
linkHint: Choose a matching confirmed invoice. Units and revenue can only be attributed once.
associateHint: Choose the same unit and exact saved variant. Stock of another size will not fulfil this request.
voiceHint: Browser speech may use vendor servers. Review the draft; customer counts are never used as unit quantities.
missingQuantity: Requested units are missing. Enter the actual quantity before saving.
micUnsupported: Microphone recognition is unavailable here. Type the request instead.
micFailed: Microphone stopped or unavailable. Your text remains editable.
featuresHint: Keep useful modules visible. Core sales, stock and customer records stay available according to role.
inviteHint: The member must have a DukaanSet account and accept a private one-use invitation.
inviteSent: Invitation prepared through the configured email channel.
permissionDenied: Your role cannot open this module
featureDisabled: This feature is turned off for this shop
passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in again; earlier sessions have been closed.
verifyHint: Use the one-use link delivered to your email before setting up your shop.
verificationSent: Verification requested. Check the configured email channel.
legacyEmail: Email not verified yet. Existing local account access is retained.
deliveryLocal: Local preview: email links are saved in a private outbox on this computer. Live email delivery is not connected.
forgotHint: Enter your email to request a private one-use reset link.
resetRequested: If a matching account exists, check its email channel for reset instructions.
resetHint: This link expires in 30 minutes and can be used once.
invalidLink: The link is missing, expired or already used. Request a new one.
registrationHint: A few details first. Set up your shop after email verification.
quickSetupHint: Inventory setup is optional. You can add products whenever you are ready.
acceptHint: Sign in to the invited account, then confirm joining this business.
ruleHint: Explainable rules over recorded demand, stock, 30-day sales and pending drafts. Requests are not guaranteed orders.
noMatch: Create or match the correct catalogue product before preparing a reorder.
saveError: Could not save. Keep this request and retry.
frozen: Save result is uncertain. Editing is locked; retry the same request.
permissionSummary: Contact permission applies to this request only.
importHint: Review a CSV before adding up to 100 new products. Required columns: name, unit, price (₹). Optional: sku, cost (₹), stock, min_stock, variant. Stock becomes opening inventory; no sales are created. Existing products are never overwritten. This shop’s module settings still apply.
importInvalid: Use a valid CSV up to 256 KB and 100 rows. Check required columns, quantities and rupee amounts.
importFirstRows: Showing the first 12 rows. Confirmation imports every reviewed row in the file.
question: Your business question
aiAnswer: AI explanation — check against your records
aiSharing: Sends your question and a limited shop summary to the configured OpenAI service. Phone numbers, emails, passwords and photos are omitted. This assistant cannot change your records.
aiUnconfigured: Live AI is not configured. The summaries above use your recorded data and explainable rules.
aiUnavailable: The AI service is unavailable. Recorded-data summaries remain available.
aiRecordedOnly: Live AI is not connected. Ask “today sales” or “today expenses” for exact recorded totals. This summary sends no data to an AI provider.
emailInstruction: Open this one-use link and confirm the action:
emailSafety: If you did not request this, ignore it. Never share this link.
followupMessage: Hello {{name}}, the {{item}} you asked about is available again at {{business}}. Reply if you are still interested.
